text:
Gold Price in 1995
Among 12 monthly observations available for 1995, the LBMA gold price rose 3.2% between 1995-01-31 ($375) and 1995-12-28 ($387). The highest sampled price was $392 in March and the lowest was $375 in January. The mean of these observations was $384. This is a first-to-last observation change, not a calendar-year return.
